title: 第11章 探子第12章 商队到来
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
哈特感觉自己自从来了开拓地之后，修炼速度就直接涨了一倍有余，许久未松动的修为正在缓慢提升。
这让他重新感受到了年轻时的感觉，斗气在身体内源源不断的滋生，一天可以修炼两次。
这让他觉得高阶骑士扈从，不再是遥不可及的目标。
他前来是汇报绿湖领的事的。
“大人，前往绿湖领的信使回来了，带来了奥斯汀男爵的回信”
罗恩接过哈特手里的羊皮纸。
“奥斯汀男爵同意了商贸的事情。还附了张临水领的骑士名单。上面标着，临水领共有两个高阶骑士扈从（鸡蛋大斗气之种），四个中阶。”
“两个高阶？”罗恩挑眉。这实力放在公国男爵里也算不错了，在这开拓地更算上老牌标准了。
两名高阶骑士扈从里，一个是鲍里斯男爵自己。另一个是他的卫兵队长叫做洛克。
哈特在一旁补充道：
“绿湖领男爵就是在这方面吃了亏，去年两个男爵领之间发生了争斗，就是被这个突然出现的高阶骑士扈从打了个措手不及。”
“此人是新突破的，不然的话，奥斯汀男爵不会主动出城堡和鲍里斯男爵对战。”
信上还写了一些临水领的基本信息，这都是奥斯汀男爵这一年来搜集的。
临水岭目前共有8000多人，一座城堡，两个小镇，农庄若干。
罗恩有些凝重，以现在的河湾领肯定不是临水领的对手。
毕竟满打满算，罗恩来到开拓地还不到两个月。
不过也不是没有好消息，起码绿湖领和临水领之间的关系确实很恶劣，而奥斯汀男爵显然是比较着急的一方。
据罗恩了解到的信息。
绿湖领的领主奥斯汀男爵已经开拓十多年了，尤其是领地上有着附近荒原上唯一的港口，依靠着便利的商贸，可谓是富得流油。
早年仗着港口便利，常卡临水领的商路，没少欺负当时还没站稳脚跟的鲍里斯。

“这就难怪鲍里斯要对他下手了。”罗恩将羊皮纸卷好，指尖在桌面轻叩。
“富得流油还实力不如人，可不就成了别人眼里的肥肉？”
哈特点头附和：
“据信使了解到的信息，奥斯汀男爵现在连商队都不敢放太远，生怕鲍里斯再搞突袭。”
“这次积极和我们合作，也是想结个善缘，最好能……”
“最好能让我们帮他分担些压力。”罗恩接过话头，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
“老狐狸打得倒是精明。”
他转头望向训练场...
content_en:
Hart felt that his cultivation speed had more than doubled since he came to the pioneer land, and his cultivation that had not been loosened for a long time was slowly improving.
This allowed him to feel the same feeling as when he was young again. Dou Qi was constantly growing in his body, and he could practice it twice a day.
This made him feel that high-level knight followers were no longer an unattainable goal.
He came here to report about the Green Lake Leader.
"Sir, the messenger who went to the Green Lake Territory has returned, bringing a reply from Baron Austin."
Ron took the parchment from Hart's hand.
"Baron Austin agreed to the trade matter. He also attached a list of knights from Zhang Linshui Territory. It is marked on it that Linshui Territory has two high-level knight retinues (the seeds of the Great Fighting Spirit of Eggs) and four mid-level knights."
"Two high-ranking people?" Ron raised his eyebrows. This strength is not bad for a baron in the principality, and it is even considered to be an established standard in this pioneering land.
Among the two high-ranking knights, one is Baron Boris himself. The other is his guard captain named Locke.
Hart added:
"The Baron of the Green Lake Territory suffered a loss in this regard. There was a fight between the two baronies last year, and they were caught off guard by the sudden appearance of this high-level knight's retinue."
"This person is a new breakthrough. Otherwise, Baron Austin would not take the initiative to come out of the castle to fight Baron Boris."
The letter also contained some basic information about the Waterfront Territory, which Baron Austin had collected over the past year.
There are currently more than 8,000 people in Linshuiling, one castle, two small towns and several farms.
Ron was a little solemn. The current River Bend Territory was definitely no match for the Linshui Territory.
After all, Ron had been planning everything, and it had been less than two months since Ron came to the pioneering land.
But it's not without good news. At least the relationship between the Green Lake Territory and the Linshui Territory is indeed very bad, and Baron Austin is obviously the more anxious party.
According to the information Ron learned.
Baron Austin, the lord of the Green Lake Territory, has been pioneering for more than ten years. Especially since the territory has the only port in the nearby wilderness, relying on convenient commerce, it can be said that he is extremely rich.
In the early years, relying on the convenient port and often blocking the trade routes in the waterfront territory, he often bullied Boris, who had not yet established a foothold at the time.
"That's no wonder Boris wants to attack him." Ron rolled up the parchment and tapped his fingertips on the table.
"If you are extremely rich but not as powerful as others, does that mean you become fat in the eyes of others?"
Hart nodded in agreement:
"According to the information the messenger learned, Baron Austin doesn't even dare to move the caravan too far for fear that Boris will launch another raid."
"This time I am actively cooperating with us because I want to have a good relationship. It would be best if..."
"It's best if we can help him share some of the pressure." Ron took over with a sneer on his lips.
"The old fox fought very shrewdly."
He turned to look at the training ground...
